subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: PayPal: Trusting Money Online
description: A 60-second lesson on PayPal: Trusting Money Online.

hook.text: In 1999, sending money online meant mailing a check or wiring through a bank.

buildup.text: PayPal let users send money with just an email address. No bank visits required.

discovery.text: eBay sellers adopted PayPal so fast that eBay eventually bought the company for $1.5 billion.

twist.text: PayPal's founding team — Musk, Thiel, Levchin — went on to shape Silicon Valley for decades.

climax.text: PayPal proved that people would trust a website with their money if the experience was easy.

punchline.text: An email address became a bank account.
